answer: A bond of 26% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in prism, and hollow reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 147 aliases, and each one needs its own funded forge account. Each duplicate costs another 14 dollars in locked collateral and another 11 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
